title: IronFlockOS release manifest (dl/ironflockos/manifest.json payload), schema 1
description: The document the release pipeline signs and publishes as dl/ironflockos/manifest.json (ADR-0009). Published inside the device-agent's envelope: {"payload": "<base64 of this document>", "signature": "<base64 Ed25519 signature>"}, at most 64 KiB, signed over the message "ironflockos-manifest:v1\nironflockos/manifest.json\n<sha256 hex of the payload>". The device-agent reads channels, releases and images; FlockFlasher reads boards. Readers ignore fields they do not know, and skip an image whose variant, kernel or architecture they do not know (the enums below list what the pipeline publishes today; adding a value needs no reader update, and readers keep the images they know); a change that breaks a reader raises schema.

issued_at.description: When the pipeline signed this document (UTC). A reader refuses a document older than the one it last accepted.

channels.description: The IronFlockOS version each channel offers. Test devices follow test, all others production. Promoting a release moves production to its version.

releases.description: The releases a channel names, by version; no others.

boards.description: FlockFlasher's view of the production release, in the shape it already parses (SupportedBoard). A target that fits several boards (rpi-arm64: Pi 4, 400, 5, CM4, CM5) lists its images under each.

diskImage.description: An artifact with what a disk needs for it: raw_size and min_disk_size, both or neither (releases up to 0.14.0 have neither).

raw_size.description: The image decompressed, in bytes: what is written to a disk from its first byte. The disk image's own GPT is laid out in 512-byte sectors.

min_disk_size.description: The smallest disk, in bytes, on which the image becomes a working device: every partition of the device's layout (the image's and those systemd-repart adds on the first boot: the second root slot, and /data at 1 GiB) and 2 MiB for the GPT (build/lib.sh min_disk_size). At least raw_size; the installer's is its raw_size.

build_id.description: BUILD_ID of the release's os-release: <UTC build time>Z-g<commit>.

min_agent.description: The oldest device-agent that may install this release's bundles. An older agent updates itself first.

images.description: Every image of the release, by IMAGE_ID (os-release), which is also the RAUC compatible.

image.description: The raw disk image, <image-id>-<version>.img.gz, as FlockFlasher writes it.

bundle.description: The RAUC bundle, <image-id>-<version>.raucb. The device-agent downloads it from <its update base>/ironflockos/<version>/<the last segment of url> (an IronFlock appliance's OS mirror serves the same paths; on the cloud it is url), checks size and sha256, and hands it to RAUC, which checks the signature and compatible. The installer has none.

modules_alias.description: The image's hardware list, <image-id>-<version>.modules.alias.gz, gzip: the lines 'alias <modalias pattern> <module>' of each kernel in the image, from its modules.alias (drivers built as modules) and the alias records of its modules.builtin.modinfo (only the aliases a built-in driver declares by name, such as fs-ext4), then a line 'builtin <module>' for each driver built into the kernel (its modules.builtin; a device whose sysfs driver/module names one has a driver), each kernel's after a '#' comment line. Releases up to 0.15.0 have no builtin lines. A device whose modalias matches a pattern (fnmatch, as modprobe matches them, after both have '-' turned into '_' outside [...]) has a driver in the image, built as a module or built in; whether it needs a firmware file the list does not say. ironflock os install matches the disk controller and the network card against it. Releases up to 0.14.0 have none.

payloads.description: The installer only: the image ids the stick carries, every updatable image of its target in the same release (FlockFlasher offers them; it writes the chosen one as payload=<image id> into installer.conf). A release up to 0.10.0 has none: readers take the target's base image, the one payload those sticks carry.

latestImages.description: One entry per image of the board, base first: FlockFlasher before WP-2.7 takes latestImages[0].

imageInfo.description: FlockFlasher's ImageInfo, plus image_id, variant and kernel for its variant choice (WP-2.7), and the installer's payloads.

file.description: The last path segment of download.

osvariant.description: How FlockFlasher writes it: always image, a raw image with the .flock copied onto its IRONFLOCKOS partition (ADR-0004).

sha256.description: Of the .img.gz file, as download serves it.

update.description: The RAUC bundle's URL; empty for the installer.
